name: Anshu Raj

education.institution: Heritage Institute of Technology, Kolkata, India
education.summary: 3rd-year ECE undergraduate with self-taught expertise in Machine Learning, data preprocessing, and API development. 1st Rank winner in SIH Internal Hackathon, Top-15 finalist among 200+ teams, and actively competing in hackathons.

research_projects.title: AURA — AI for Unified Regional Access
research_projects.summary: Built an offline Hindi-to-Tribal speech translation system integrating ASR, translation retrieval, transliteration, and speech synthesis. Integrated 82,598+ Hindi–Santali translation pairs into an indexed SQLite database for efficient retrieval.

research_projects.title: Deep Learning Image Enhancer
research_projects.summary: Developed an AI-based image enhancement tool to restore blurry microscopic images. Improved image quality and generated 2x higher-resolution outputs.

research_projects.title: WhatsApp Chat Analyzer
research_projects.summary: Built a WhatsApp chat analysis tool to extract insights from exported chat data. Analyzed user activity, message trends, and chat statistics with clear visualizations and interactive dashboard.

hackathons_and_achievements: Winner (1st Rank) & Runner-Up – SIH Internal Hackathons (2024, 2025)
